title: Anthony Constantino
intro:
Anthony Constantino (Republican Party, Taxpayer Rights Party) is running for election to the U.S. House to represent New York's 21st Congressional District. He is on the ballot in the general election on November 3, 2026. He advanced from the Republican primary on June 23, 2026.
Constantino completed Ballotpedia's Candidate Connection survey in 2026. Click here to read the survey answers.
